hero.subtitle: Cubicost BIM-based quantity surveying and cost estimation for construction projects.

paragraphs: Adopt Cubicost for BIM-integrated BOQ generation, cost estimation, and change management. Aptus Infotech provides licensing and implementation support for quantity surveyors and contractors in Oman.

items.title: BIM Integration
items.body: Extract quantities directly from Revit and other BIM models.

items.title: BOQ Generation
items.body: Automated bill of quantities aligned to measurement standards.

items.title: Cost Control
items.body: Track variations and update estimates as designs evolve.

items.title: Reporting
items.body: Exportable reports for tendering and project controls.

items.title: Authorized Partner
items.body: Genuine software licenses with official support channels and compliant procurement.

items.title: Implementation Support
items.body: Guidance on deployment, licensing models, and integration with your existing workflows.

items.title: Local Expertise in Oman
items.body: Muscat-based team providing responsive sales, technical support, and training across the GCC.

items.title: End-to-End Service
items.body: From license procurement and renewal to rollout planning — a single trusted partner.
